energy_contract.reason: The service c1 anchor carries both generic OpenROAD PPA power and a separate activity-backed service-window power measurement. The temporal/finalizer and FIFO rows carry only standalone OpenROAD physical power estimates. The report therefore preserves separate power views and remains a bounded/provisional energy input rather than an exact token-energy ranking.
